description: Complete 3-floor castle dungeon with main paths, optional side-rooms, enemy ecology, puzzles, and final boss encounter

floor_1_outer_ward.name: Outer Ward
floor_1_outer_ward.atmosphere: Moonlit ruins, collapsed roofs, overgrown gardens

enemy_types.name: Campers (Cursed Servants)
enemy_types.spawn_reason: Former castle staff possessed by corruption

enemy_types.name: Roamers (Optional)
enemy_types.spawn_condition: Only if main gate left open at night

puzzle.name: Banner Sigils
puzzle.description: Four torn banners must be arranged in correct family order
puzzle.solution: Match heraldic symbols to faded wall murals

optional_side_rooms.entrance: Hidden behind cracked wall (requires Earth spell or heavy attack)

enemies.name: Treasure Wraith
enemies.special_ability: Gold Curse - slows movement when hit

rare_drops: Treasury Key (opens locked chest on Floor 2)

loot.chest: Fangkey chest with legendary weapon part

floor_2_lower_keep.name: Lower Keep
floor_2_lower_keep.atmosphere: Water-damaged corridors, echoing drips, rusted weapons

enemy_types.name: Stone Sentinels
enemy_types.behavior: Slow but tanky, ground slam attacks
enemy_types.weakness: Lightning to stun, then combo attacks

enemy_types.name: Elite Camper (Former Advisor)
enemy_types.drops: Gold shards x3, Purple gem, Advisor's Signet Ring

puzzle.name: Moat Gate Valves
puzzle.description: Three water valves must be turned in sequence to drain flooded passage
puzzle.solution: Follow water flow direction carved into walls
puzzle.reward: Drains water, reveals hidden path to Floor 3

optional_side_rooms.entrance: Requires Water Walking spell or creat with swimming ability

enemies.name: Drowned Scholar
enemies.special_ability: Curse Pages - random debuffs (slow, silence, confusion)

enemies.name: Water Wraiths
enemies.description: Spectral figures rising from flooded floor
enemies.special_ability: Drown Grasp - pulls player underwater briefly

rare_drops: Lore book: The Fall of the Crown
loot.chest: Soulkey chest with creat evolution fruit

optional_side_rooms.special_feature: Readable books provide lore about castle's corruption

optional_side_rooms.entrance: Unlocked with Treasury Key from Floor 1 (if found)

enemies.name: Corrupted Captain
enemies.description: Elite stone sentinel with tactical AI

enemies.name: Wraith Soldiers
enemies.description: Mix of archers and melee wraiths

rare_drops: Armor set blueprint: Royal Guard Set
loot.chest: Fangkey chest with legendary armor piece

optional_side_rooms.special_feature: War table shows map of castle with marked secret passages

floor_3_high_throne.name: High Throne Room
floor_3_high_throne.theme: Corrupted throne hall and royal chambers
floor_3_high_throne.atmosphere: Dark energy pulses, shattered stained glass, ominous crown glow

enemy_types.name: Royal Guards (Spear & Shield)
enemy_types.spawn_reason: Elite guards corrupted by crown's power
enemy_types.weakness: Break shields with heavy attacks, then combo

pre_boss_puzzle.name: Throne Seal
pre_boss_puzzle.description: Four elemental braziers must be lit in correct order
pre_boss_puzzle.solution: Match seasonal cycle shown in throne room murals (Spring→Summer→Fall→Winter)
pre_boss_puzzle.hint_location: Royal astronomer's notes on side table

optional_side_rooms.entrance: Hidden passage behind throne (revealed after lighting braziers)

enemies.name: Vault Guardian
enemies.description: Massive stone sentinel with crown fragment embedded in chest
enemies.special_ability: Crown Pulse - AoE damage wave, Petrify Gaze - temporary stun

optional_side_rooms.special_feature: Contains portraits of royal family with lore descriptions

optional_side_rooms.entrance: Side door from throne room (always accessible)

enemies.name: Fallen Priest
enemies.description: Elite court magus with dark healing abilities
enemies.special_ability: Corrupt Blessing - heals enemies, damages player

enemies.name: Possessed Choir
enemies.special_ability: Dirge of Despair - reduces player stats temporarily

rare_drops: Chapel key (opens secret in Royal Vault)
loot.chest: Soulkey chest with rare creat egg

optional_side_rooms.special_feature: Purification Talisman provides buff against Corrupted Monarch

boss_encounter.name: The Corrupted Monarch
boss_encounter.title: Last King of the Fallen Realm

appearance.description: Once-noble king now twisted by crown's corruption
appearance.visual: Tattered royal robes, glowing eyes, crown fused to skull, dark energy aura
appearance.weapon: Corrupted scepter that shifts between sword and staff

phase_1.name: Regal Fury
phase_1.behavior: Aggressive melee with scepter, occasional crown pulses

attacks.name: Crown Pulse
attacks.description: Dark energy wave from crown, must dodge or block

attacks.name: Scepter Combo
attacks.description: 3-hit combo with knockback on final strike
attacks.counter: Dodge final strike, punish with combo

attacks.name: Shadow Grasp
attacks.description: Dark tendrils shoot from ground, immobilize briefly
attacks.telegraph: Ground darkens where tendrils will emerge

phase_1.strategy: Learn attack patterns, dodge crown pulses, attack during recovery windows

phase_2.name: Desperate Dominion
phase_2.behavior: Summons wraith archers, uses possession beam, more defensive
phase_2.phase_transition: Monarch kneels, crown flares, summons 4 wraith archers

attacks.name: Possession Beam
attacks.description: Red beam from crown attempts to possess player, reverses controls if hit
attacks.counter: Hide behind pillars or use Purification Talisman

attacks.name: Royal Command
attacks.strategy: Kill archers quickly or they overwhelm you

attacks.name: Corrupted Barrier
attacks.description: Creates shield that reflects damage, must be broken with elemental crits
attacks.counter: Use opposing element to boss's current aura

phase_2.strategy: Manage adds, break barriers with elemental crits, avoid possession beam

phase_3.name: Crown's Wrath
phase_3.behavior: Enraged, crown takes control, extremely aggressive
phase_3.phase_transition: Monarch screams, crown fully engulfs head, dark aura intensifies

attacks.name: Desperate Fury
attacks.description: Rapid melee attacks with no recovery, must maintain distance
attacks.counter: Use ranged attacks, creat assists, defensive spells

attacks.name: Crown Explosion
attacks.description: Massive AoE that covers entire arena, must hide behind pillars

attacks.name: Shadow Swarm
attacks.description: Dark energy fills arena, constant damage over time
attacks.counter: Use healing items, Light spells reduce damage

phase_3.strategy: Survive crown explosions, manage health carefully, use all resources, coordinate with creat for sync attacks

defeat_sequence.description: Crown shatters, monarch collapses, dark energy dissipates
defeat_sequence.cutscene: Monarch's eyes clear, speaks final words of gratitude, passes peacefully
defeat_sequence.restoration: Throne room light returns, stained glass repairs itself, kingdom begins healing

blueprints: Legendary weapon: Scepter of the Restored King
special_drops: Permanent buff: +5% to all stats in castle zones

enemy_ecology_notes.description: How forest enemies naturally appear in castle ruins

connections.reason: Collapsed roofs and broken windows created entry points
connections.locations: Outer Ward, any room with ceiling damage

connections.reason: Former castle residents possessed by corruption, became stationary
connections.locations: All floors, especially servant quarters and guard posts

connections.reason: Wandered in through open gates at night, patrol borders
connections.locations: Outer Ward only, if gates left open

enemy_ecology_notes.design_philosophy: Enemies feel organic to environment, not randomly placed

progression_summary.recommended_approach: First run: main path only. Subsequent runs: explore side-rooms for better loot
